WHEN POWER MEETS POISE
Regal’s available ALL-WHEEL-DRIVE (AWD) system isn’t just for snow. It offers enhanced traction,
whether the road is wet or dry. Combined with an electronic limited-slip differential, AWD helps
maximize traction by sending power to the wheel(s) with the most grip. In low-traction situations—
such as rain, sleet or snow—it can send up to 50 percent of engine torque to either front wheel and
up to 85 percent to either rear wheel. And on dry roads, the benefits include enhanced acceleration,
providing torque to all four wheels. AWD is available on every 2016 Regal trim level.
